recognize_zh: 中央一顆大型細胞有三個圓形核，細胞質豐富、深藍嗜鹼性並帶小空泡，周圍還有數顆核偏位、藍色細胞質的單核漿細胞，可認出為多核（三核）漿細胞。
features: Large plasma cell containing three round, separate nuclei
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with scattered small clear vacuoles
Nuclei with coarse to clock-face chromatin; one nucleus shows a faint nucleolus
Adjacent mononuclear plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and pale perinuclear hof
Smear background with red cells and a small lymphocyte
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large trinucleated plasma cell with abundant deep blue cytoplasm containing small vacuoles and three round nuclei with coarse chromatin. Several nearby mononuclear plasma cells show eccentric nuclei and perinuclear clearing. Multinucleation is a cytologic atypia seen more often in neoplastic than reactive plasma cells, but it is not diagnostic in isolation. Findings are suggestive of a plasma cell neoplasm; quantification of plasma cells and demonstration of clonality (light chain restriction by IHC/ISH or flow cytometry) are required.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are usually mature, mononuclear and polytypic for kappa and lambda, whereas multinucleation and nucleoli favor neoplasia.
Osteoclasts are much larger with many (often more than five) uniform nuclei and granular, less basophilic cytoplasm without a perinuclear hof.
Erythroid precursors have round central nuclei, very dark blue cytoplasm and lack the eccentric nuclei and hof of plasma cells.
Plasmablastic lymphoma has larger cells with vesicular chromatin and prominent central nucleoli and is often EBER positive in immunodeficient patients.
